messages.text: The cookware set hasn’t been recorded as returned, and we can only refund items after they’ve been received back (refund-policy/v1/return). If you’ve already sent it back, tell me and I can ask a staff member to check. Otherwise, once it’s returned and recorded, I can help submit a refund request.
